title: Create: Industrial Compat
description: Turn steel and bronze items from one Create mod addon into their counterparts from another and more!
body:
Have you ever had too many Create mod addons that add the same items and wish that they could be more compatible for crafting? This datapack helps with that by allowing you to turn items from one mod into their counterparts from another using the Stonecutter.

## ⚙️ What this datapack adds:
- Stonecutter recipes for:
  - Steel and Bronze Nuggets, Ingots, Blocks, and Sheets.
  - Charcoal and Coal Dust
- A shapeless recipe to craft Flint and Steel from a Flint and a Steel Ingot

## ✨ Supported mods: 
- [Create Big Cannons](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-big-cannons)
- [Create: Gunsmithing](https://modrinth.com/mod/cgs)
- [Create: Ironworks](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-ironworks)
